prompt: Which statements about the three action types are true? Choose all that apply.
explanation: The three types are one ladder of isolation: JavaScript runs on the runner, Docker brings its own container (Linux runners only), composite brings nothing — just steps folded into the caller. All three may be listed on the Marketplace.

options.text: A JavaScript action runs code directly on the runner under its declared Node runtime
A Docker action executes inside a container built from your Dockerfile
A composite action bundles steps, including `uses:` of other actions, with no runtime of its own
Docker actions run natively on Windows and macOS runners
Only composite actions can be published to the Marketplace
